response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems developer with strong software craftsmanship credentials, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: he lacks the required 8 years of C++ programming (only a brief 2014-2015 stint plus a small thesis project), has no demonstrated large-scale cloud compute platform or distributed infrastructure leadership experience, and his career has centered on web/product engineering (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than cloud architecture or hardware/compute infrastructure at scale.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across multiple domains and languages
Demonstrated mentoring, teaching, and community leadership (workshops, talks, open-source projects)
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, testing frameworks he authored)
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months full-time plus a student project), far short of the required 8 years
No evident experience with large-scale cloud compute platforms, distributed systems at scale, or hardware/storage architecture
Career trajectory is generalist full-stack/web development, not specialized infrastructure or cloud platform technical leadership

key_factors.factor: Lack of large-scale cloud/distributed infrastructure experience
Strong general software leadership and mentoring background
